dish: Okinawa soba (ash-lye noodles, bonito broth, boneless rib)
address: near Motobu Municipal Market, Motobu, Okinawa, Japan
w: Soba shop founded in 1905 near the Motobu market: flat noodles still made with tree-ash lye water, in a light bonito-and-soy broth with thick boneless rib, kamaboko and island onion.

n: King Tacos Kin (キングタコス 金武本店)
w: The taco-rice institution in downtown Kin: seasoned taco meat, cheese, lettuce and tomato over rice — the dish created in Kin in 1984 by Matsuzo Gibo of Parlor Senri.
